payouts.missingBody: Bookparking charges the driver, keeps a {{fee}}% commission and sends you the rest, at the latest 24 hours after each rental starts — as soon as they arrive if they confirm it.
payouts.stripeNote: Your identity and IBAN are entered at Stripe, our payment provider: Bookparking never sees them.

payouts.readyBody: Each rental goes to your bank account, less the {{fee}}% commission.

deletion.title: Delete my account
deletion.intro: Your listings are taken off the site; your email address, your password and your notifications are erased. Your past bookings remain, with no link to you. This is permanent.
deletion.blocked: Only possible once no request is awaiting an answer, no booking is ongoing or upcoming, and no payout is still owed to you.
deletion.dialogBody: The account cannot be restored. Enter your password to confirm.
deletion.done: Your listings are no longer online and your personal data is erased. Thank you for using bookparking.
deletion.privacy: What bookparking keeps, and for how long
